claim_limit: One fused GEMM+bias+exact-GELU+row-softmax shape on RTX 6000 Ada. Feasibility is an implementation-path outcome, not a language ceiling.
failure_policy: Every one of 228 requested cells receives exactly one terminal audit outcome. Unsupported, import, build, launch, correctness, and frozen-gate failures remain in the denominator; no implementation fallback is permitted.

frozen_gate.timing_eligibility: A launchable cell must pass every threshold in all 4 cases x 64 validation seeds x 2 gates before either timing phase.

hardware.audit_gpu_policy: Deterministic cells may be sharded across GPUs 0--3; feasibility/build/gate outcomes are not timed.

inference.cell_interval: Exact central order-statistic interval for a population median; n=15 uses [x4,x12] with coverage 0.96484375.
inference.common_feasible_definition: A grid is common-feasible for a strategy only when all four lane cells build, launch, and pass the complete fused-v2 gate.
inference.feasibility_estimand: Terminal-outcome counts and rates by strategy, lane, and their interaction, always over all 19 requested grid cells.
inference.performance_scope: Strategy/lane contrasts are descriptive unless restricted to the corresponding common-feasible grid intersection.
inference.selection_rule: Within each strategy x lane stratum, rank gate-legal cells by the median of two independent process medians; freeze the top two plus g01 when g01 is legal (deduplicated).
inference.stability_estimand: Positive-versus-withheld-signed changes in cell median, within-stratum rank, and selected winner; no cross-GPU timing comparison.

preregistration_policy: Freeze source and dependency hashes, commit the lock, and require the launch commit to be present on its configured upstream before GPU execution.

strategy_contracts.global_intermediate: The lane-native GEMM writes an fp32 global intermediate; one common checked CUDA kernel performs bias, exact erf GELU, and complete row softmax.
strategy_contracts.register_fused: Bias and exact erf GELU are applied to accumulator fragments before the first global store; a lane-local implementation of the common row-softmax algorithm follows.
strategy_contracts.smem_staged: The complete accumulator tile is explicitly staged in per-block shared memory before bias and exact erf GELU; a lane-local implementation of the common row-softmax algorithm follows.
